ActivityLevel.description:
Physical activity level categories for adults.

The four categories of the National Academies' *Dietary Reference Intakes for Energy* (2023),
which EFSA (2013) also uses with almost the same values. Factors live in
:mod:`annona_core.nutrition.settings`; :mod:`annona_core.nutrition.activity_quiz` helps a user
pick one.
ActivityLevel.title: ActivityLevel

Allergen.description: The 14 allergens that must be declared in the EU (Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011, Annex II).
Allergen.title: Allergen

kcal_diff_pct.description: per 100 g/ml, versus what the menu used
kcal_diff_pct.title: Kcal Diff Pct

Appliance.description: What a cooking step uses. ``none`` = no cooking (salads, yogurt, sandwiches).
Appliance.title: Appliance

Category.description: Coarse product category. Finer grouping lives in ``Product.type`` (free text).
Category.title: Category

CategorySource.description: Who set a product's category. See :data:`CATEGORY_SOURCE_PRIORITY`.
CategorySource.title: CategorySource

skip_products.description: products to leave out of the deduction
skip_products.title: Skip Products

Equipment.description: The household kitchen. Cooking times are adapted with the calibration, not by hob model.
Equipment.title: Equipment

HeatLevel.description: Recipes speak in low/medium/high heat, never in hob power numbers (see CLAUDE.md).
HeatLevel.title: HeatLevel

NutritionFacts.description: Nutrient amounts per 100 g (``basis=g``) or per 100 ml (``basis=ml``).
NutritionFacts.title: NutritionFacts

NutritionSource.description: Where nutrition values (or allergens) come from. See :data:`NUTRITION_SOURCE_PRIORITY`.
NutritionSource.title: NutritionSource

PantryOut.description: A pantry item with the product's name and category, so clients can group and label it.
PantryOut.title: PantryOut

Product.description:
Something you can buy. Store products carry ``store_id`` + ``store_sku``; generic foods
(e.g. sample data) have neither.

allergens.description: None = unknown; [] = known to contain none of the EU 14
allergens.title: Allergens

allergens_source.description: who set the allergens; same priority as nutrition sources

Product.title: Product

ProductPatch.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Manual data is never overwritten by automatic sources.
ProductPatch.title: ProductPatch

calibrated.description: boil times come from the user's hob measurement
calibrated.title: Calibrated

generated.description: false when a stored recipe was reused
generated.title: Generated

ingredients.description: the household's total for this meal
ingredients.title: Ingredients

ScheduleIn.description: Which meals to plan. weekday 0 = Monday.
ScheduleIn.title: ScheduleIn

Sex.description: Biological sex, used only by the BMR formula (Mifflin-St Jeor).
Sex.title: Sex

pantry_effect.description: what ticking or unticking did to the pantry (PATCH only)

Shortfall.description: A constraint that cannot be met, and by how much.
Shortfall.title: Shortfall

TargetWarning.description: Machine-readable warnings; the app shows a translated message for each.
TargetWarning.title: TargetWarning

reason.description: not_sold (no equivalent in this store) | no_type
reason.title: Reason

allergies_confirmed.description: True once the user explicitly answered the allergy question (an empty list then really means 'no allergies')
allergies_confirmed.title: Allergies Confirmed

food_preferences.description: product type -> 'avoid' (never bought for them) or 'less' (small amounts)
food_preferences.title: Food Preferences

protein_g_per_kg.description: protein target in g per kg of body weight; None = the default for the goal (0.8 g/kg is the adult reference intake, 3 g/kg the top of what sports research uses)
protein_g_per_kg.title: Protein G Per Kg

info.description:
Self-hosted API of **Annona**, the open-source weekly meal planner.

Authenticate with **Authorize** using the server's `ANNONA_API_TOKEN`. Slow operations (plan
generation, price refresh) return a job: poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}`.
Nutrition is informational, not medical advice.
info.title: Annona API

get.description: Stores that have products in the database (the ones a plan can be made for).

schema.title: Response Catalog Stores Api V1 Catalog Stores Get
Response Get Equipment Api V1 Equipment Get

get.description: AI calls and known cost per task and model (cache hits excluded).

schema.title: Response Llm Usage Api V1 Llm Usage Get

post.description: Mark the meal as cooked and deduct it from the pantry (once).

get.description: What marking this meal as cooked would take from the pantry. Changes nothing.

post.description: The detailed recipe of a planned meal (10-30 s the first time, then stored).

get.description: The active plan of the week starting on ``week`` (a Monday), or null.

schema.title: Response Plan For Week Api V1 Plans Get

post.description: Optimise the shop and draft the week with the AI (25-90 s): poll the returned job.

get.description: The plan's list at a store (default: the most recent one).

post.description: The plan's list at the chosen store: built the first time, then kept with its ticks.
Refresh prices now with the providers in ANNONA_REFRESH_PROVIDERS (also runs daily).

get.description: Members with today's daily targets (informational, not medical advice).

schema.title: Response List Profiles Api V1 Profiles Get

get.description: Configured AI models and whether their keys are set on the server (read-only).

patch.description: Tick (bought: the packs go to the pantry) or untick (they are taken back) an item.

post.description: Cheapest purchase meeting the household's targets at one store, or why that is impossible.

get.description: Installed supermarket providers. Opt-in ones show the notice the user must accept.

schema.title: Response Stores Api V1 Stores Get

get.description: Meals planned for a day (default today) in the active plan: the base of the home screen.

schema.title: Response Today Api V1 Today Get
